patterns.note: The hero section integrates a detailed app UI mockup to visually demonstrate product functionality upfront.
Key benefits and call-to-action words in section headlines are highlighted with a vibrant orange contrasting color.
The brand's accent orange is consistently used for all calls-to-action, selected text highlights, and the footer background.
Feature lists are presented in multi-column card layouts, each featuring a large icon and a concise descriptive paragraph.
Sections use alternating background colors (white, light beige, black, orange) to create clear visual separation and flow.

technique_notes: To highlight specific words in headings, wrap them in a span element and apply a distinct contrasting color via CSS.
Create feature sections using a CSS Grid or Flexbox to arrange cards, each containing an icon and a brief textual explanation, ensuring uniform spacing and alignment.
Visually separate page sections by alternating background colors (e.g., light gray, white, dark black) to break up content and improve readability.
